_doc: Site tracing v1 (lane S2): polygons traced BY A CLAUDE AGENT (vision) on the per-framing median background of A1+ TRAIN frames ($INTERCYCLE_DATA/cal/<framing>_bg.png; same sources as k1_v1.json), in full-resolution RAW pixels. scripts/cal_v1.py site undistorts them with k1_v1, maps them through the CAL v1 H and writes twin/site.yaml. Polygon vertices are rough (+-20 px on clear floor edges, +-40-60 px where noted). floor = the floor the framing sees (machines, walls, stacked die plates and the far floor beyond the cut row excluded; small movable objects such as chairs, bins and stands are left in). footprint = the press base where it meets the floor. Ram ROIs come from docs/probes/S3a-P4_rois.json unchanged.

P9a.note: the 100 t eccentric press in the camera-9 foreground; floor contact traced on c9_f0 (left plinth, right column foot); the front edge is cut by the frame bottom, so the footprint is a lower bound in depth (+-40 px)

P9b.note: the C-frame press behind P9a; its base is hidden behind P9a's crown in both framings, so the footprint is ASSUMED: a 1.4 m square centred on the floor point below its column in c9_f0 (pixel (340, 225), +-60 px)

P14a.note: front edge = base on the floor; back edge hidden (+-40 px)

P14b.note: front edge = base on the floor; back edge hidden (+-40 px)

P14c.note: front edge = base on the floor; back edge hidden (+-40 px)

P14d.note: front edge = base on the floor behind the operator's seat; back edge hidden (+-40 px)
